item.title: Power outages reported across the region
item.description: A number of power outages have been reported in the Northern Sound region. 244 customers are currently without power in the Errigal area while 81 customers are affected in Killeshandra. Elsewhere in Co Cavan, 1,897 customers in Ballyjamesduff are affected. Bailieboro has 1,069 without power. Advertisement ESB has apologised for the loss of supply and says its currently working to repair a fault affecting premises and will restore power as quickly as possible. Advertisement

item.description: Ellie Brady has signed for AFLW side Collingwood. item.description: Well known actress, Tina Kellegher says Cavan holds a very special place in her life. Tina who played Sharon Curley in The Snapper grew up in Cavan Town. item.title: Concerns raised over N53 Blayney to Dundalk Road
item.description: A Monaghan Senator is calling for further funding to be allocated for upgrade works on the N53. Senator Gallagher recently raised the issue of the N3 which is the national road that leads from Castleblayney to Dundalk. Senator Gallagher highlighted that DkIT has approximately 5,000 students, this includes many students from Cavan, Monaghan, Meath and Louth who travel on the N53 road to get to DkIT. item.title: New Bank of Ireland branch opens in Monaghan Town
item.description: The new Bank of Ireland branch in Monaghan Town officially opened its doors today. This follows its relocation from Church Square to a newly refurbished property nearby at The Diamond. The new branch will provide customers with a larger, brighter, and more modern space to conduct all their banking needs, with improved wheelchair access. item.description: Planning permission has been given for a new development at a luxury hotel in Co Cavan. item.title: More funding for local SOSAD services 'essential'
item.description: Cavan councillor Brendan Fay is calling for more funding to be allocated to SOSAD services. He was reacting to CSO figures which showed that 2020 recorded the largest number of female deaths due to suicide in a five-year period between 2018 and 2022. Overall, the five-year average of suicides between 2018 and 2022 in Ireland was 526. item.title: Two people killed on Derrylin road named
item.description: The two men who died following a collision on the Derrylin Road in Co Fermanagh were Michal Lisiecki and Adam Telus, the Police Service of Northern Ireland has confirmed. Michal (42) and Adam (25) were living in Galway and sadly died following a collision involving their Ford Kuga and a bus on the Derrylin Road on Friday evening, 28th November.
